name: Premarket Desk · 盘前早报
tagline: A three-minute morning brief on your US watchlist before the opening bell
description: Ahead of the US open it sends a short brief: index futures, Treasuries, crude and the dollar, how your pasted tickers moved overnight, plus the AI and chip names. Earnings and data calendar included, plus a taste of what finance X is arguing about. Holdings that report get a same-evening readout.
